Subject: Vendor identity & PO field mapping for Aurum AP portal

Hi Emma / Aurum AP team,

Following our latest contract milestone, we need to complete vendor registration so invoices can route correctly against customer POs. Attaching our vendor onboarding template and W‑9 for your records. Can you confirm the exact PO/invoice fields your AP portal expects so we can pre-populate on our side and avoid routing delays? Specifically we need to confirm:

- Required PO field name(s) (PO_NUMBER, PO_REF, PO_LINE?) and max length
- Invoice URN / document reference field used by Aurum for matching
- Remit/bank ID expected (IBAN / ACH / SWIFT) and whether you require a sample voided check or DocuSign bank verification
- VAT/EORI requirements for EU shipments and whether a VAT registration number or self‑billing opt‑out is needed
- Any specific vendor categories / tax certificates (W8/W9 equivalent) required for payment hold exceptions
- Preferred invoice format (PDF + JSON metadata / Peppol / CSV) and an endpoint for e‑invoices if available

Attachment(s): redwood_vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_w9.pdf (pdf)

Goal: have vendor record activated and first invoice pay‑ready before the first production invoice (planned 2026‑10‑05). If useful, Marissa (cc) will handle bank proof and tax docs — can we schedule a 30‑minute onboarding call?

Thanks,

From: Emma Steele <emma.steele@aurum.co>

Subject: Re: Vendor identity & PO field mapping for Aurum AP portal

Hi Jordan — thanks for the details and the attachments. Attaching our Aurum AP packet that outlines required fields and acceptable evidence. Key points from our side: 

- Our portal requires PO_NUMBER (15 chars max) and an optional REMIT_ID (our internal remit routing id). PO line level is supported but not required for initial matching.
- Invoice matching: we look for invoice metadata "documentReference" and the embedded PDF filename. If you can send invoices with a short JSON header (invoice_number, invoice_date, net_amount, po_number) that speeds matching.
- Bank verification: we require one of the following — (a) voided bank account screenshot + bank statement, (b) DocuSign bank verification (preferred for non‑US entities). Link included below.
- VAT: For EU entities we require VAT registration or an EORI when goods/services cross borders. Aurum supports self‑billing on a per‑supplier basis; if you want self‑bill enabled we need a signed form (section 4 in the packet).
- Tax certificates: W9/W8BEN or local equivalent required before first payment. If any withholding applies we will advise during PO creation.

Attachment(s): aurum_ap_packet.pdf (procurement packet)
DocuSign bank verification: https://www.docusign.com/rsrcs/aurum/bank-verification/1234

Two quick clarifications: do you have a single remit bank for Redwood (US) and an EU bank for VAT settlement, or will Aurum route cross‑border wire/ACH? Also confirm whether Net30 is acceptable — standard Aurum terms are Net30 unless otherwise negotiated.

If you can complete the packet and bank proof by end of week we can flip the vendor to active and issue the first PO. Happy to do a quick call — how does Fri 2026‑10‑01 09:00 BST / 01:00 PDT look?

Best,
Emma Steele
Senior Procurement Manager — Aurum Systems
emma.steele@aurum.co
